tutorials.title: Multiworld Setup Guide
tutorials.description: A guide to setting up Stray for Archipelago.This guide covers single-player, multiworld, and related software.
tutorials.text:
# Your game here!

## Required Software

- A v4.0.1 copy of Casualties: Unknown from itch.io (latest release)
- The [client mod](https://github.com/Nichologeam/CUAP/releases) for Casualties: Unknown
- A copy of the Archipelago text client, which can be installed [here](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases)

## Configuring your YAML file

### What is a YAML file and why do I need one?

Your YAML file contains a set of configuration options which provide the generator with information about how it should
generate your game. Each player of a multiworld will provide their own YAML file. This setup allows each player to enjoy
an experience customized for their taste, and different players in the same multiworld can all have different options.

### Where do I get a YAML file?

You can customize your options by visiting the [Casualties: Unknown Options Page](/games/Casualties%20Unknown/player-options).

### Connect to the MultiServer

1. Install the client mod by extracting the zip folder into the game's directory.
	- If done correctly, a BepInEx folder should appear.

2. Launch the game normally and click past the introductory story.

3. In the top right, enter the room connection information.
	- If you want to run with Deathlink, click the 'Deathlink' button.
	- If you don't, just click 'connect'

4. To ensure the mod works correctly, exit to the main menu if you ever disconnect before reconnecting.
	- You can save your progress with the console command 'failsave', accessable by pressing ` ingame.

readme.text:
# StrayAP
Archipelago client implimentation for Stray built on [lua-apclientpp](https://github.com/black-sliver/lua-apclientpp).

This mod requires the [experimental version of UE4SS](https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/releases/tag/experimental-latest), and has only been tested to work on the Windows Steam version of Stray. Your mileage may vary on other versions.

## Installing
1. Download the latest UE4SS experimental release.
2. Navigate to your Stray files. This can be done by right-clicking the game in your Steam Library, hovering over Manage, and selecting Browse Local Files.
3. Navigate to Hk_project > Binaries > Win64
4. Unzip UE4SS inside this folder so `dwmapi.dll` is inside the Win64 folder.
5. Navigate to the mods folder (Mods or ue4ss > Mods depending on version) and unzip the Latest StrayAP Release into that folder.
6. Start Stray. Follow the onscreen instructions to connect.

## AI Usage Disclaimer
This is my first time ever modding Unreal Engine, and is my first real attempt at coding in Lua. Along with reading copious amounts of [documentation](https://docs.ue4ss.com/index.html), I did occasionally use AI Language Models as [rubber ducks](https://rubberduckdebugging.com/). **None of the code inside the mod or APWorld is generated by AI, nor will any code inside either ever be**.

notes.text:
### Stray Archipelago v0.0.4
This update is compatible with worlds generated on all previous versions.

For instructions on how to set up and play this mod, check the [README](https://github.com/Nichologeam/StrayAP/blob/master/README.md).

# Changes:
- Logic now accounts for needing to fix the tracker before giving it to Seamus to finish Slums Part 2
	- You now need the Poncho, Broken Tracker, and Fixed Tracker to logically finish the chapter
# Fixes:
- Fixed `Scratching Spot - Slums Meditation Room` not logically requiring the flat keys [APWorld Change]
- Fixed receiving items throwing an error sometimes
- Attempted to try fixing the inventory corruption issues
# Known Issues:
- Items received for later chapters are not added to the backpack. This is to prevent a crash that I will try and find a workaround for later
- Receiving or resyncing the Outsider Notebooks while inside the Slums will cause B-12 to play its corresponding dialogue
- Receiving certain items at certain times can corrupt the inventory, causing a crash on the next checkpoint load. I'm looking into this

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Nichologeam/StrayAP/compare/v0.0.3...v0.0.4
